corpus_row.why_safe: Confusion axis: TERT carries an authentic RT fingers-palm-thumb fold with the canonical RT motifs, so any RT-HMM/domain-based TE caller can match it exactly as it matches LINE ORF2p or LTR pol. Tool-independence: Collins & Gandhi identified p133 by biochemical purification of the telomerase RNP and epitope-tagging/functional assay in Tetrahymena, not by homology search or repeat annotation. The deposit is the mRNA of a single-copy nuclear host gene, with no LTRs, no TIRs, no target-site duplications and no gag/transposase ORF.
